about: Files moved here byte for byte from the engine repository by a lane of the case engine-down-to-five-jobs: each names its source path and commit, the identity of its source bytes there and of its bytes here. A file that differs from its source names, in dropped_lines, the source lines it lost: path dependencies a Cargo.toml had on crates that stay in the engine or now sit in another tool, and a word and an example address that the private-data push gate refuses (replaced by candidates and example.com).

files.found_by: the composition-ast and ops-core path dependencies this file lost in the move are back, at tools/shared-code/crates/<crate>
